This form is used to define valid function groups for an application.
A function group is a name that can be associated with a logically-related
set of functions to control access to those functions. Each menu selection
must be assigned to a function group, and an access level within that
function group. Correspondingly, each user is assigned a specific access
level for each function group in the system. The user can only execute
those functions for each his/her access level is sufficiently high for
that particular function group.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 enter;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from fcn_grp
 where appl_id = :GLOBAL.appl_id and
 grp_id = :fcn_grp.grp_id;
 message('Msg: This group already exists.');
 :ctrl_block_1.appl_id := :GLOBAL.appl_id;
 :ctrl_block_1.s_grp_id := :fcn_grp.grp_id;
 clear_block(no_validate);
 execute_query; 
 next_item;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then

 when OTHERS
 then

 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 t_grp_id VARCHAR2(5);
begin
 if :fcn_grp.grp_id is null
 then
 message ('Err: group id must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
--
 if :fcn_grp.descrip is null
 then
 message ('Err: group description must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
--
 begin
 select grp_id into t_grp_id
 from fcn_grp
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and substr(grp_id,4,2) = substr(:fcn_grp.grp_id,4,2)
 and grp_id != :fcn_grp.grp_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 if t_grp_id is not null
 then
 message ('Err: Duplicate function group. '|| t_grp_id || ' exists.'
);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
--
end;
